name: InputNumber
usage: Numeric settings such as days, time limits, quantities and sort order

props.name: precision
props.description: Number of decimal places shown and kept.

props.name: controls
props.description: Shows the step buttons.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.

props.name: suffix
props.description:
Content after the number, inside the field, such as a unit. The field grows by the width of the suffix, so
the number keeps the room it has without one.

props.name: block
props.description:
Fills the width of the container (like Select and DatePicker); by default the field is just wide enough for a
number of about eight digits and its suffix.

props.name: ref
props.description: Handle of the field.

modes.title: Number value (default)
modes.description:
For ordinary numeric values such as days, ports and counts: `value`, `defaultValue`, `min`, `max` and `step` are
numbers, and `onChange` receives a number (`null` when the field is emptied).

props.name: decimal
props.description:
Passes the value as a decimal string instead of a number. Use it for exact values such as amounts: the value
never goes through floating point, and `min`, `max` and `step` are strings too.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (controlled); `null` when empty.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value; `null` when the field is emptied.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest value.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value.

props.name: step
props.description: Step of the buttons and the arrow keys.

modes.title: Decimal string value: `decimal`
modes.description:
For exact values such as amounts and quantities: `value`, `defaultValue`, `min`, `max` and `step` are decimal
strings such as `"1280.50"`, `onChange` receives a decimal string (`null` when the field is emptied), and the value
never goes through floating point.

props.name: decimal
props.description: Passes the value as a decimal string.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value as a decimal string (controlled), such as `"1280.50"`; `null` when empty.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value as a decimal string; `null` when the field is emptied.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest value, as a decimal string.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value, as a decimal string.

props.name: step
props.description: Step, as a decimal string such as `"0.01"`.

types.name: InputNumberRef
types.summary: Handle of InputNumber: focus, blur, and the native element.

fields.name: focus
fields.description: Focuses the field; `cursor` places the cursor or selects the text.

fields.name: nativeElement
fields.description: The outer element of the field.

types.name: FocusOptions
types.summary: Where to put the cursor when focusing a text field: at the `start`, at the `end`, or select `all` of the text.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Set lower and upper limits; digits use tabular figures.

examples.name: StringMode
examples.title: Exact values
examples.description:
Use `stringMode` for amounts and quantities: the value is passed as a string and never goes through
floating-point numbers.

examples.name: InSetting
examples.title: In a setting
examples.description: Place it in the `control` of a SettingRow.
